body.text: Compare to mod-off: the walk's frame row (FRAME_BUDGET, walk_storeroom_raid) passes when mod-on p99 frame time is within 10% of the same colony's mod-off arm measured in the same run; both arms must be MEASURED or the row is UNMEASURED (never a pass). The 50 ms barrage bar (barrage_frame_budget) is unchanged.
body.said: Compare to mod-off (Recommended): Why: the question is what the mod costs, not what 316 mods cost. Pass if mod-on is within 10% of the same colony's mod-off run (today: +3.6%). Buys an honest, passable row today with no rebuild. Costs: the bar becomes relative, so a slow colony no longer fails by itself. Recommended: it measures the thing the bar was written to protect.

authority.by_card: How should the walk's frame row be judged? → Compare to mod-off (Recommended)
